NOTE
**Close — linked issue no longer has "help wanted", and the author has no merged PRs**

New: The author replaced the screenshot links and edited the description, with no new code push. Missing: Issue #37030 had "help wanted" dropped on 2026-09-04 because it needs discussion, and it is now marked "core team candidate". The screenshots are therefore moot, since contributors may only work on "help wanted" issues.

###### Next step

Close the PR, since the issue is not open to contributors: `gh pr close 40085`.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the PR and for updating the screenshots. We're closing this because #37030 no longer has the "help wanted" label (it needs discussion first), and we only accept contributor PRs for issues with that label.
```
